name: Udi's Gluten-Free Delicious Soft White Sandwich Bread
whyItWorks: Made from a smooth blend of tapioca starch, brown rice flour, and egg whites. Light and airy with zero seeds, zero nuts, and negligible fiber. Highly digestible for compromised intestinal linings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Best served toasted in a toaster oven for 2 minutes to bring out warmth and softness without crumbling.
